scripts.dev:api: cd ../server && ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://localhost:5001 dotnet run --project VAOIG.FwaRiskTriage.Api --no-launch-profile
scripts.dev:db:migrate: cd ../server && dotnet tool restore && dotnet ef database update --project VAOIG.FwaRiskTriage.Infrastructure --startup-project VAOIG.FwaRiskTriage.Api
scripts.dev:local: bun run dev:db && bun run dev:db:migrate && sh -c 'cd ../server && ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development ASPNETCORE_URLS=http://localhost:5001 dotnet run --project VAOIG.FwaRiskTriage.Api --no-launch-profile & api_pid=$!; cd ../client; NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5001 next dev -p 3000; status=$?; kill $api_pid 2>/dev/null; wait $api_pid 2>/dev/null; exit $status'
